newsitem.title: USA: Allstate reports higher earnings, raises dividend.
newsitem.headline: Allstate reports higher earnings, raises dividend.

text.p: Allstate Corp. Thursday reported higher earnings for the fourth quarter and increased its quarterly dividend by more than 10 percent.
Chubb Corp., the property-casualty insurer, also reported higher profits.
Northbrook, Ill.-based Allstate said it earned $595 million, or $1.33 a share, in the fourth quarter, up from $397 million, or 88 cents a share, in the 1995 quarter.
Revenues grew to $6.06 billion from $5.85 billion.
The major insurance company said property-liability revenues rose 2.8 percent in fourth quarter, primarily due to lower catastrophe payments and a growth in premiums.
After-tax catastrophe losses were $114 million vs. $148 million a year ago.

Allstate said statutory premiums, which include all premiums and deposits, grew 6.3 percent in the fourth quarter of 1996. This increase was driven by sales of new annuities, as well as universal life products, Allstate said.
The company raised its quarterly dividend to 24 cents a share from 21.25 cents.
For the year, earnings rose to $2.07 billion, or $4.63 a share, from $1.90 billion, or $4.24 a share, in 1995. Revenues rose to $24.3 billion from $22.79 billion.
Allstate stock fell 12.5 cents to $63.75 on the New York Stock Exchange.
Chubb reported higher fourth quarter earnings, with life insurance income more than double a year before.
Warren, N.J.-based Chubb reported fourth quarter earnings of $203.8 million, or $1.15 a share, up from $193.5 million, or $1.09 a share a year earlier.
Life and health insurance income after taxes amounted to $12.9 million in the fourth quarter compared with $6.2 million a year earlier, it said.
For the year, Chubb earned $694.7 million, or $3.91 a share, compared with $696.6 million, or $3.93 a share a year earlier.
For the year, life and health insurance income was $40.3 million compared with $28.0 million in 1995.
The company did not provide consolidated revenue figures.
Chubb stock rose 37.5 cents to close at $55 on the NYSE.
